import pytest
from tiktoken.core import Encoding
def test_chunk_encoding():
    enc = Encoding(name="test", pat_str=r\\\"\\\w+\\\", mergeable_ranks={}, special_tokens={})
    text = "This is a long text that needs to be chunked."
    chunk_size = 10
    expected_chunks = [
        "This is a lo",
        "ng text that",
        " needs to be",
        " chunked."
    ]
    token_chunks = enc.encode(text, chunk_size=chunk_size)

    # Assuming each chunk is encoded separately and the output is a list of token lists
    assert len(token_chunks) == len(expected_chunks)
    for i, chunk in enumerate(expected_chunks):
        assert enc.encode(chunk) == token_chunks[i]
if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main(["-x", "-q"])
